cohort: The study included 208 postnatal females aged 20-34 who had undergone Caesarean section and had diastasis recti abdominis muscles measuring more than 2.5 cm.
finding: Neuromuscular electrical stimulation (NMES) combined with abdominal exercises was more effective at reducing diastasis recti abdominis muscles (DRAM), improving abdominal muscle strength, and waist-hip ratio than abdominal exercises alone in postnatal women.
